The tan/chocolate/coral/navy identity remains recognizable on gray, light and dark backgrounds. No directional ground shadow, target-image halo, flashing normals, detached garment animation or material clipping was found in the inspected frames and playback.

Hair remains the material shortfall against frozen ranked outcome1. N is dominated by a broad rounded rectangular hair shell with the sweep appearing as a separate rim at the top. Small tan wedges remain at the sweep/bang joins.
